correctness.rationale: For a fixed pair sum, the quartic power sum is exactly a quadratic polynomial in the pair product. Equality therefore factors into the diagonal product equality and one affine involution. Ordered-pair multiplicities are exactly 1+chi(discriminant); summing the diagonal and involution contributions reduces to elementary quadratic-character sums. The standard Jacobi sum is applied only with nonzero parameter because characteristics 2 and 3 are excluded. The resulting formula was also replayed by exact collision counts over 24 prime fields and three quadratic extensions.

value.rationale: Additive energy is the exact fourth-moment invariant underlying finite-field restriction at even exponent. For the simplest omitted-power nonlinear graph beyond the parabola, the complete all-field formula shows a genuine arithmetic phase transition controlled by cube roots of unity. This is a natural structural invariant rather than a finite table, and it supplies an exact benchmark for future sharp quartic-graph extension theory.
